title: Perimeter, your way
prompt: The robot measures a rectangular room. Write a helper called `print_perimeter` that prints the distance around a rectangle, and call it from `solve` with the width and height. You decide its parameters. solve(3, 4) prints 14.
hints: The perimeter is twice the width plus twice the height, so the helper needs both.
solve passes its two values straight through.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
